messages.text: Where is my order? Order # Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your Airsquitter (4DSKY) is packed at our Brampton warehouse and waiting on the carrier pickup. Nothing has left yet, so there's no tracking number to give you, but it goes out as a packed parcel and the tracking email lands the moment the carrier scans it.

I'm sorry it has taken this long since October 11. That's longer than it should have been for a unit we hold in stock.

Anything else you want me to check on it?

No delivery date yet, and I won't guess one. Until the carrier scans the box and gives us a tracking number, there's no transit estimate to read from. Once it ships, the tracking page shows the delivery window for your Miami address, and that email goes to you automatically.

It's packed and queued for pickup, so it should move in the next few days. If it hasn't shipped by the end of this week, come back here and I'll chase it with the warehouse.
Thanks for your patience on this one. The tracking email comes to you the moment it leaves Brampton, and I'm here if anything looks off.
